title: Jubilant Indian Gulab Jamun Dessert
description: A Mexican-inspired twist on the traditional Indian dessert, featuring jubilant gulab jamun dough balls in a sweet and tangy light syrup.

ingredients.name: light syrup
ingredients.notes: equal parts water and sugar, simmered until dissolved

ingredients.name: gulab
ingredients.notes: dried or fresh, rehydrated and chopped

ingredients.name: jamun
ingredients.notes: dried or fresh, rehydrated and chopped

instructions: 1. Combine light syrup and gulab in a saucepan, bringing to a boil over medium heat.
2. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until syrup has thickened slightly.
3. Add jamun and vanilla extract (if using) to the syrup, stirring to combine.
4. Meanwhile, cut jubilant dough into small balls, about 1-inch in diameter.
5. Fry dough balls in hot oil until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
6. Remove fried dough balls from oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Add fried dough balls to the syrup and toss to coat.
8. Serve warm or at room temperature, garnished with chopped cardamom (if using).
9. Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
10. Reheat in the microwave or on the stovetop before serving.
